policy.name: CIS Ubuntu Linux 24.04 LTS Benchmark
policy.description: Center for Internet Security benchmark for Ubuntu Linux 24.04 LTS

check.title: Ensure permissions on /etc/crontab are configured
check.description: The /etc/crontab file contains instructions for system cron jobs.
check.rationale: Incorrect permissions could allow unauthorized users to modify scheduled system jobs.
check.remediation: Run chmod 600 /etc/crontab and ensure the file is owned by root:root.
